subject: micro_aust issue: RNetCDF not recognising NetCDF files from AWAP?

messages.author: 6e196974265cd2ef
messages.subject: micro_aust issue: RNetCDF not recognising NetCDF files from AWAP?
parts:
Hi all,

Another beginner NicheMapR user here. I've been playing around with micro_aust, but have hit a bit of a snag where .nc files from AWAP are not recognised.

I've chosen a single point in Australia for a single year (2009) and can extract microclimatic data using micro_global, but when I run micro_aust, I hit the following error code:

extracting climate data via opendap - note that there is no wind speed data, so the daily range is assumed to be from 0.5 to 2 m/s

extracting climate data

reading weather input for variable rad for year 2009
Error in RNetCDF::open.nc(paste0(baseurl, var, "/day/", year, "/bom-",  :
  NetCDF: Unknown file format

I can't work out the issue exactly...I have the most up to date version of R and all associated packages (e.g. ncdf4, RNetCDF), so am wondering whether it is the openDAP connection to AWAP data that might be the problem (given that AWAP is currently being updated)?

Not sure if my issue can be reproduced - it ran OK on the Shiny version of NicheMapR...but that runs of local files(?) - but any help would be appreciated!

Cheers,
Chloe.

messages.author: e46cb5dd353b7dfb
messages.subject: Re: micro_aust issue: RNetCDF not recognising NetCDF files from AWAP?
parts:
Hi Chloe,

Sorry but there was an opendap link to the 'AWAP' data in the past but that appears to have been disconnected. This site indicates that there will be a release at some point but for now you'll just have to play with it via the shiny app which is connecting to a local instance of the data that I've set up. You can always use the micro_ncep function instead.

All the best,
Mike
